mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a pleasant 72 degrees at Verona City Hall. Tonight features a first quarter moon, and if you look up at 9:35 PM, you can spot the International Space Station flying from the direction of Cross Plains toward the Oregon area near Costco, passing almost directly overhead.

The City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker design contest for local students in grades K through 12, with the top entries appearing in the November election. Additionally, the City continues its routine engineering service updates through AECOM, which are regularly reported to the City Council.

Today is packed with activities including Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park at Century School Park, and Hop Haus Trivia this evening. Looking ahead, tomorrow brings live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly look at police activity, on July 13, officers responded to a call where a 36-year-old man was arrested for an O-W-I after his vehicle was found stuck on a large rock.
Today's featured flavor is the decadent Chocolate Covered Strawberry. Culvers is open until 10 PM this evening, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop before they close.
